g.text: Customer 360 — Dagster Scaled Backend · UAT vs PROD
Same architecture, different scale. Daemon is always ×1 (singleton — no leader election). Webserver + worker pools scale per environment.
Run flow: customer360-api → Service → webserver → daemon (QueuedRunCoordinator) → K8sRunLauncher → pool pod (run+step K8s Jobs) → Postgres · S3
9 × code-location gRPC servers (dagster api grpc — identity_resolution, segmentation, analytics, …)
Worker pools · routed by dagster/pool tag
9 × code-location gRPC servers (dagster api grpc — identity_resolution, segmentation, analytics, …)
Worker pools · routed by dagster/pool tag
Σ workers ≈ 70 vCPU / 180 Gi (the conceptual target)
Shared state — no local SQLite, no local logs (both prerequisites for >1 replica)
Target state on VKS (GreenNode Kubernetes). Both UAT and PROD run on vServer (VM + Docker + SSH) today — migration tracked in vks-migration-technical-analysis.md.
